title: Kissed Peppery Venezuelan Lamb Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful Venezuelan dish featuring lamb shanks, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal that can cure hangovers. The combination of peppery and juicy flavors will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shanks with black pepper, coriander, cumin, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Sear the lamb shanks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb shanks from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb shanks to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 2 1/2 hours.
